prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding flows can produce major wins (up to +12.0%), but carries risk of severe drops (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with predictions often being inaccurate.
Targeted copy changes for account persistence (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA performance underpredicted (+0.5% predicted vs +6.7% measured); general intro copy showed no clear effect.
Interactive flows (+7.2%) and interactive waiting screen enhancements (+3.9%) were helpful and outperformed initial predictions, though a new preview screen showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns yielded zero winning tests and carried severe downside risk (down to -19.3%), consistently performing worse than predicted or showing no clear effect.
Hints showed no wins, either actively hurting performance (-3.1%) or producing no clear effect.
Notifications and layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +6.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +7.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% over 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Deferred to Post-Waiting Step: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet generation on the waiting screen, right before entering the desktop intro. (why: Moving sign-in after users see their generated pet increases commitment and completion rates.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Playroom Minigame: Adds interactive companion toy animation controls on the waiting screen while pet generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a high median duration of 201s; interactive activities keep users engaged and reduce drop-off during rendering.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Practice Screen: Adds a new screen (new_desktop_practice) before final setup where users test moving, summoning, and toggling their companion. (why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to control or hide their companion after setup.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Adoption Certificate Account Preservation Banner: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in prevents pet data reset and loss upon logging back in. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Progress Countdown: Displays live progress and estimated time indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and high drop-off; clear progress expectations keep users engaged.)
5: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Launch Call to Action: Updates the final launch CTA button copy on home_intro to explicitly action 'Launch Pet onto Desktop Now'. (why: Launch CTA tweaks historically delivered +6.7% gains, and support received complaints about pets not showing on desktop.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Dock Position Selection Screen: Adds a new screen (new_dock_setup) allowing users to pick their pet's initial desktop placement (Taskbar, Corner, Center). (why: Support tickets reported pets missing or misbehaving on the desktop after onboarding completed.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Account Sign-In Safeguard Highlight Notice: Adds a visual highlight badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing cloud sync and data preservation. (why: 8 support emails were received about missing pets or reset data after signing in again.)

scores.note: Reordering carries high risk and historical gains for sign_in reorder are modest (+1.2%).
Interactive waiting flows perform strongly (+7.2%) and directly address 201s wait time.
Adding new screens historically shows no clear effect or slight drops (-2.5%).
Account persistence copy changes consistently perform well (+3.5%) with support validation.
Waiting info enhancements consistently lift engagement (+1.7% to +3.9%) on long wait steps.
Launch CTA copy updates previously delivered +6.7% and address active support tickets.
New setup screens carry implementation cost and tend to reduce target conversion (-2.5%).
Notifications show no clear positive effect across tests (-1.3%).
